questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question expressing doubt or alternative possibilities.
questions.question: I wonder ___ he intends to submit his dissertation.

questions.def: 'Whether or not' is a formal way to introduce an indirect question implying alternatives.
questions.question: The professor inquired ___ all the students had completed the assignment.

questions.def: Indirect questions don't use 'that' before the question word.
questions.question: He asked that did I know where the dean's office was.

questions.def: Use 'whether' to introduce indirect questions; subject-verb agreement is crucial.
questions.question: I am unsure ___ the university ___ about the changes.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question expressing doubt or a choice.
questions.question: They haven't decided ___ to proceed with the research, given the limited funding.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question expressing doubt.
questions.question: I'm not certain ___ he'll be able to attend the conference next month.

questions.def: 'Wonder' introduces the indirect question; maintain correct tense and agreement.
questions.question: I ___ if she ___ planning to attend the lecture.

questions.def: 'Whether' is used for indirect questions involving a choice/uncertainty.
questions.question: The committee discussed ___ the proposed amendments should be implemented.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question concerning compliance.
questions.question: They are investigating ___ the company complied with the environmental regulations.

questions.def: 'Unclear whether' introduces an indirect question regarding data support.
questions.question: It's ___ ___ the data supports the hypothesis.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces the indirect question about the policy's impact.
questions.question: The study examines ___ the new policy has had a significant impact.

questions.def: 'Whether' is the correct way to introduce an indirect question.
questions.question: I am inquiring ___ you have received the documents I sent last week.

questions.def: Auxiliary verbs are not used in indirect questions.
questions.question: She wondered did she remember to lock the door or not.

questions.def: 'Unsure whether' introduces an indirect question questioning accuracy.
questions.question: They are ___ about ___ the results are accurate.

questions.def: 'Whether' is used to present an indirect question that has a yes/no answer.
questions.question: The researchers are investigating ___ the sample was contaminated.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question about the significance of data.
questions.question: The article explores ___ the findings are statistically significant.

questions.def: The preposition 'to' is not needed before 'me' when using 'asked'.
questions.question: He asked to me if I had finished reading the book.

questions.def: 'Question whether' introduces an indirect question about replication.
questions.question: The scientists ___ ___ the experiment can be replicated.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question about the regulations' effectiveness.
questions.question: It remains to be seen ___ the new regulations will be effective.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces the indirect question about the project schedule.
questions.question: The supervisor wanted to know ___ the project was on schedule.

questions.def: 'Doubt whether' introduces an indirect question expressing uncertainty about approval.
questions.question: I ___ ___ the funding will be approved.

questions.def: 'Whether' is used to show they are uncertain on implementing the strategy.
questions.question: The team is considering ___ to implement the new strategy.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question concerning a decision.
questions.question: The board discussed ___ to accept the proposal.

questions.def: 'Questions whether' implies the research accuracy is being doubted.
questions.question: The author ___ ___ his research is accurate.

questions.def: 'Whether' presents a reliable economic forecast as an indirect question.
questions.question: The analyst is unsure ___ the economic forecast is reliable.

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces an indirect question about breaking laws.
questions.question: The investigation will determine ___ any laws were broken.

questions.def: "Whether" introduces an indirect question expressing doubt or alternative possibilities.
questions.question: I wonder ___ he intends to finalize the agreement.

questions.def: "Whether" is the correct subordinator when reporting an inquiry about a yes/no question.
questions.question: The report investigated ___ the company violated environmental regulations.

questions.def: In indirect questions, "whether" or "if" is used, not "that", after verbs like "enquire".
questions.question: The professor enquired that the students had understood the lecture.

questions.def: Indirect questions use statement word order (subject + verb) and correct tense.
questions.question: They asked ___ he the answer.
